W.name: Wedge
W._description: The obtuse-angled shaft tip makes it difficult to tilt, and the 10-tooth gear reduces stamina loss when sprinting.

K.name: Kick
K._description: Kicks the inside of the stadium with angled shaft-tip sides, enabling movement leading to continuous attacks and counter-defence.

GR.name: Gear Rush
GR._description: Designed to extend the gear of the R-BIT to the tip to improve the ease of hooking onto extreme lines.

Z.name: Zap
Z._description: A design combining dynamic attack with a flat shaft, equipped with a large gear and static defense with a central protrusion.

WB.name: Wall Ball
WB._description: Designed with a cylindrical wall around the shaft tip of the B BIT to prevent tilting of the BEY.

Tr.name: Turbo
Tr._description: When rotating at high speed, it maintains stable motion with a fine shaft tip, and when rotation slows down, it transforms into a thick shaft tip and re-accelerates, enabling an X-DASH.

M.name: Merge
M._description: The blunt-edged shaft tip is wrapped with a high-friction rubber material, providing both grip and endurance.

TK.name: Trans Kick
TK._description: K-BIT with height mode change function. The height can also be changed with an X-DASH during battle. The angular shaft-tip sides can be used to deploy both continuous attacks and counter defences.

I.name: Ignition
I._description: The large cylindrical shaft end, featuring multiple protrusions, grips firmly to the stadium, enabling high-speed manoeuvrable attacks.

Y.name: Yield
Y._description: A design that achieves both endurance performance through a large spherical shaft tip and attitude control performance via weights projecting in four directions.

WW.name: Wall Wedge
WW._description: The area around the shaft tip of the bluntly pointed W BIT is enclosed by a cylindrical wall, further reducing the BEY’s tendency to tilt.

J.name: Jolt
J._description: Combines attacks that minimise STAMINA loss through a slender, flat shaft tip with high-speed X-DASHES enabled by large gears.

Op.name: Operate
Op._description: A structure allowing selection between a defensive mode, featuring four deflecting BLADES and a slender shaft tip to withstand attacks, and an offensive mode, featuring two aerodynamically structured BLADES and a thick shaft tip for manoeuvring.

PHOENIX.name: Phoenix
PHOENIX._description: A Phoenix-model LOCK CHIP that secures the CX BLADE.

LEON.name: Leon
LEON._description: Lock component for the Leon model securing the CX BLADE.

CERBERUS.name: Cerberus
CERBERUS._description: Cerberus model locking parts to fix CX BLADES.

DRAN.name: Dran
DRAN._description: Dran model's locking parts secure the CX BLADE.

EMPEROR.name: Emperor
EMPEROR._description: The lock component for securing the CX BLADE on the Emperor model. The LOCK CHIP whose weight has increased due to the metal parts.

FOX.name: Fox
FOX._description: Fox model's locking parts secure the CX BLADES.

HELLS.name: Hells
HELLS._description: Hells model's locking parts secure the CX BLADES.

PEGASUS.name: Pegasus
PEGASUS._description: Locking parts for the Pegasus model that secure the BLADES of the CX.

PERSEUS.name: Perseus
PERSEUS._description: Perseus model lock parts that secure the CX BLADE.

RHINO.name: Rhino
RHINO._description: Rhino model's locking parts secure the CX BLADES.

SOL.name: Sol
SOL._description: Sol model lock parts that secure the CX BLADES.

VALKYRIE.name: Valkyrie
VALKYRIE._description: Valkyrie model locking parts to secure CX BLADES. LOCK CHIP with increased weight due to metal parts.

WHALE.name: Whale
WHALE._description: Locking parts for the Whale model that secure the BLADES of the CX.

WIZARD.name: Wizard
WIZARD._description: Wizard model lock parts that secure the CX BLADE.

WOLF.name: Wolf
WOLF._description: Wolf model locking component for securing the CX BLADE.

BAHAMUT.name: Bahamut
BAHAMUT._description: Bahamut model locking parts for securing the CX BLADES.

KNIGHT.name: Knight
KNIGHT._description: The lock component for the knight model securing the CX BLADE.

RAGNA.name: Ragna
RAGNA._description: The locking component for the Ragna model securing the CX BLADE.

RAGE.name: Rage
RAGE._description: A streamlined, smooth BLADE designed to deflect an opponent's attack and minimise rotational loss.

BLITZ.name: Blitz
BLITZ._description: A heavyweight five-BLADE design offering superior striking performance. Combined with a large BLADE featuring an offset centre of gravity, it enhances heavy-hitting capabilities.

FORTRESS.name: Fortress
FORTRESS._description: The design employs a shape with varying elevations to disperse the opponent's attacks, generating counter-strikes through the three-dimensional BLADE form.

B.name: Break
B._description: A design that enhances playability by shifting the centre of gravity.

G.name: Guard
G._description: Three large BLADES are positioned facing upwards, achieving powerful counter performance that deflects smash attacks from opponents.

F.name: Flow
F._description: Designed with a thin, smooth shape to reduce air resistance while maintaining rotational force.
